sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: FLAG staining confirmed surface expression at the membrane of pituitary somatotropes and somatomammotropes in transgenic mice, with colocalization with membrane markers Ghrhr, Pit-1, GH, and PRL. Function (GH secretion) was studied in these mice but explicit preservation of receptor function relative to untagged GPR101 is not stated in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: L3 explicitly states the FLAG tag is placed at the N-terminus of GPR101, preceded by an exogenous signal sequence, in all transfection constructs. GPR101 carries no endogenous signal peptide (raw topology begins O=extracellular at residue 1), so after cleavage of the exogenous ss the FLAG tag is the new N-terminus immediately before M1 (insert_after_residue=0, residue_after=M). The native extracellular N-terminal span (residues 1–31) provides 31 residues of buffer before TM1 at residue 32, satisfying the ≥3-residue boundary constraint. L2 independently confirms surface display of the FLAG-tagged receptor by immunostaining in vivo. All GPR101 receptor constructs used for stable and transient transfection were cloned with a FLAG epitope (DYKDDDDK) at the N-terminus preceded by an exogenous signal sequence (KTIIALSYIFCLVFA). GPR101 has no endogenous signal peptide (topology: extracellular 1–31); after cleavage of the exogenous ss, FLAG sits before native M1. The same N-terminal FLAG design was used in transgenic mice (rat Ghrhr promoter driving FLAG-Gpr101).

sources.claim: All receptors were cloned into the pIRESpuro vector (Clontech Laboratories, Mountain View, CA, USA) (for stable transfections) and/or pcDNA3.1 (Invitrogen Corporation, Carlsbad, CA, USA) (for transient transfections) after addition of the FLAG epitope (DYKDDDDK) at the N-terminus, preceded by the signal sequence (ss) KTIIALSYIFCLVFA 61 , unless specified otherwise.

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) derive from the same publication (PMC7506554) and describe the same N-terminal FLAG-tagging strategy. No internal loop insertions, C-terminal tags, or other junction positions are reported anywhere in the ledger. The exogenous signal sequence (KTIIALSYIFCLVFA) is not part of GPR101's canonical sequence and is cleaved; the FLAG tag is therefore at the extracellular N-terminus (before M1). No specific residue number is cited for the junction, but 'N-terminus' combined with the extracellular topology of residues 1–31 leaves exactly one position (insert_after_residue=0), making this topology_derived. ECL1 (90–105), ECL2 (171–191), and ECL3 (425–433) are not addressed by any ledger line and therefore yield no sites.
